text:
amy: Release window in 20m. deploybot says promote blocked because build 12122 failed artifact-verify on integration.
lee: ugh, I just looked - the job failed during fetch with checksum mismatch for dist/service-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.
ci-bot: [job 12122] linux-x86_64/integration FAILED after 00:03:10 exit_code=1
infra-bot: detected elevated S3 5xx during upload window ~12:14 UTC, some uploads retried.
amy: is there a safe fallback? can we pin to last good 12110?
deploybot: promote blocked reason: artifact verification failed for build 12122. Manual pin allowed to build 12110.
lee: 12122 includes a minor lint change and a build tool bump. No security fixes. 12110 is safe.
release-manager: options: wait for rerun (may be slow), re-run artifact upload from CI cache, or manual pin to 12110 and continue with change window.
amy: prefer not to extend the window. pin sounds best.
lee: one caveat: the release-notes generator pulls the commit range; if we pin to 12110 we'll need to backfill the small items from 12122 manually.
release-manager: I'll take that. I'll add a note in the release notes about the pin and include ENG-3892 for the checksum investigation.
ci-bot: scheduling debug rerun of 12122 with verbose upload logs, artifacts stored in debug bucket only.
deploybot: manual promote queued for build 12110 by @release-manager. Canary will start in 8m, rollback threshold 4% error rate.
infra-bot: tagging infra owners @lee for post-release analysis: possible parallel upload + cache eviction race.
lee: filing a follow-up: ENG-3892 assigned to @lee and @infra-team.
amy: release-manager please confirm when promote goes live.
release-manager: promote started canary at 2% traffic. monitoring.
deploybot: canary stable at 2% for 5m, no regressions. Escalation not needed.
amy: proceeding with release. closing thread, will reopen if deploybot reports anomalies. :white_check_mark:
